concerns.text: SC-002 states "The robustness of the findings is measured against the consistency of p‑values across different geographic regions and magnitude thresholds" but does not define a quantitative metric (e.g., allowable variance, confidence interval, or proportion of p‑values below α). Without a concrete threshold the criterion cannot be objectively measured.

SC-003 mentions "variation in significance rates" when sweeping the cutoff but does not specify how that variation is quantified (range, standard deviation, max‑diff, etc.) nor what constitutes acceptable stability. The lack of a measurable definition makes the success criterion untestable.

FR-009 requires exclusion of events where "interpolation reliability is < 95%" but the spec does not describe how reliability is computed or what data source provides that reliability estimate. Without a defined method the edge case cannot be reliably triggered or verified in tests.
